entry.canonical: Rabbi Elazar, son of Yose ben Halafta
entry.canonicalHe: רבי אלעזר ברבי יוסי בן חלפתא
aliases: Rabbi Elazar b. Yose ben Halafta
entry.bio: Rabbi Elazar was a son of Rabbi Yose ben Halafta. Shemot Rabbah 52:5 describes Shimon bar Yochai asking him about his father's teaching.

sources.title: Aharon Hyman, Toldot Tannaim veAmoraim: Elazar son of Yose ben Halafta

reviewNotes: Keep separate from the later Eretz Yisrael amora rabbi-elazar-b-yose.
Hyman explicitly cites the Shemot Rabbah 52 story under the son of Yose ben Halafta.
Tannaitic status is supported; a numbered generation and date range are not assigned by this record.
